theory Logic

Logic

Intuitionistic predicate logic, De Morgan, quantifiers, and squash.

Intuitionistic predicate logic, encoded as types (NuPRL §9.1.4).

Connectives are soft: `True` is `Unit`, `A ∧ B` is `A × B`, `∀` is `Π`, `∃` is `Σ`. Squash `[A]` hides the extract of `A`. `P{i}` is the propositional universe, a display form for `U{i}`.

44 theorems, 0 abstractions, checked by replaying their tactic scripts on the kernel. Hover any piece of syntax for its kind, surface form, and uniform term; open Tactics, Proof, or Analysis to go deeper.

Original source file
-- | Intuitionistic predicate logic, encoded as types (NuPRL §9.1.4).
--
-- Connectives are soft: `True` is `Unit`, `A ∧ B` is `A × B`, `∀` is `Π`,
-- `∃` is `Σ`. Squash `[A]` hides the extract of `A`. `P{i}` is the
-- propositional universe, a display form for `U{i}`.
theory Logic

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- True / False / Unit / Void
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem true_intro :
  True
proof
  intro
qed

theorem unit_intro :
  Unit
proof
  intro
qed

theorem true_unique :
  ∀x:True. x = Ax ∈ True
proof
  intro x
  eq
qed

theorem false_elim :
  ∀A:U{i}. False → A
proof
  intro A
  intro p
  elim 2
qed

theorem void_elim :
  ∀A:U{i}. Void → A
proof
  intro A
  intro p
  elim 2
qed

theorem ex_falso :
  ∀A:P{i}. False → A
proof
  intro A
  intro p
  elim 2
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Conjunction
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem and_intro :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. A → B → A ∧ B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro a
  intro b
  split THENL [hyp 3, hyp 4]
qed

theorem and_elim_left :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. A ∧ B → A
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro p
  elim 3
  hyp
qed

theorem and_elim_right :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. A ∧ B → B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro p
  elim 3
  hyp
qed

theorem and_comm :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. A ∧ B → B ∧ A
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro p
  elim 3
  split THENL [hyp 5, hyp 4]
qed

theorem and_assoc :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. (A ∧ B) ∧ C → A ∧ (B ∧ C)
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro p
  elim 4
  elim 5
  split THENL [hyp, split THENL [hyp, hyp]]
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Disjunction
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem or_intro_left :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. A → A ∨ B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro x
  left
  hyp
qed

theorem or_intro_right :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. B → A ∨ B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro y
  right
  hyp
qed

theorem or_elim :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. (A → C) → (B → C) → A ∨ B → C
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro f
  intro g
  intro d
  elim 6 THENL [
    elim 4 with u THENL [hyp, hyp],
    elim 5 with v THENL [hyp, hyp]
  ]
qed

theorem or_comm :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. A ∨ B → B ∨ A
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro d
  elim 3 THENL [right THEN hyp, left THEN hyp]
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Implication, modus ponens, K and S
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem implies_id :
  ∀A:U{i}. A ⇒ A
proof
  intro A
  intro x
  hyp
qed

theorem modus_ponens :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. (A ⇒ B) ⇒ A ⇒ B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro f
  intro x
  elim 3 with x THENL [hyp, hyp]
qed

theorem implies_k :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. A → B → A
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro x
  intro y
  hyp 3
qed

theorem implies_s :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}.
    (A → B → C) → (A → B) → A → C
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro f
  intro g
  intro x
  elim 5 with x THENL [
    hyp,
    elim 4 with x THENL [hyp, elim 8 with y THENL [hyp, hyp]]
  ]
qed

theorem implies_trans :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. (A → B) → (B → C) → A → C
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro f
  intro g
  intro x
  elim 4 with x THENL [hyp, elim 5 with y THENL [hyp, hyp]]
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Negation
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem not_intro :
  ∀A:U{i}. (A → False) → ¬A
proof
  intro A
  intro f
  intro a
  elim 2 with a THENL [hyp, hyp]
qed

theorem not_elim :
  ∀A:U{i}. ¬A → A → False
proof
  intro A
  intro n
  intro a
  elim 2 with a THENL [hyp, hyp]
qed

theorem contradiction :
  ∀A:U{i}. A → ¬A → False
proof
  intro A
  intro a
  intro n
  elim 3 with a THENL [hyp, hyp]
qed

theorem dni :
  ∀A:U{i}. A → ¬¬A
proof
  intro A
  intro x
  intro n
  elim 3 with x THENL [hyp, hyp]
qed

-- ¬¬¬A → ¬A is constructive (unlike full DNE).
theorem triple_neg :
  ∀A:U{i}. ¬¬¬A → ¬A
proof
  intro A
  intro nnn
  intro a
  lemma dni [A] THEN elim 4 with a THENL [hyp, elim 2 with y THENL [hyp, hyp]]
qed

theorem contrapositive :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. (A → B) → ¬B → ¬A
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro f
  intro nb
  intro a
  elim 3 with a THENL [hyp, elim 4 with y THENL [hyp, hyp]]
qed

theorem not_false :
  ¬False
proof
  intro p
  hyp
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Biconditional
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem iff_refl :
  ∀A:U{i}. A ⇔ A
proof
  intro A
  split THENL [intro x THEN hyp, intro x THEN hyp]
qed

theorem iff_sym :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. (A ⇔ B) → (B ⇔ A)
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro p
  elim 3
  split THENL [hyp, hyp]
qed

theorem iff_mp :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. (A ⇔ B) → A → B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro p
  intro a
  elim 3
  elim 5 with a THENL [hyp, hyp]
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Quantifiers
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem forall_elim :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:(A → U{i}). (∀x:A. B x) → ∀a:A. B a
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro f
  intro a
  elim 3 with a THENL [hyp, hyp]
qed

theorem exists_intro :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:(A → U{i}). ∀a:A. B a → ∃x:A. B x
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro a
  intro b
  exists a THENL [hyp, hyp]
qed

theorem exists_elim :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:(A → U{i}). ∀C:U{i}.
    (∃x:A. B x) → (∀x:A. B x → C) → C
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro p
  intro f
  elim 4
  elim 5 with u THENL [hyp, elim 8 with v THENL [hyp, hyp]]
qed

theorem exists_fst :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:(A → U{i}). (∃x:A. B x) → A
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro p
  elim 3
  hyp
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Distributivity and constructive De Morgan
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem and_or_distrib :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ∀C:U{i}. A ∧ (B ∨ C) → (A ∧ B) ∨ (A ∧ C)
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro C
  intro p
  elim 4
  elim 6 THENL [
    left THEN split THENL [hyp 5, hyp],
    right THEN split THENL [hyp 5, hyp]
  ]
qed

-- ¬(A ∨ B) ⇔ ¬A ∧ ¬B, both directions constructive.
theorem de_morgan_or :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ¬(A ∨ B) → ¬A ∧ ¬B
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro n
  split THENL [
    intro a
    elim 3 with (inl a) THENL [auto, hyp],
    intro b
    elim 3 with (inr b) THENL [auto, hyp]
  ]
qed

theorem de_morgan_or_rev :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ¬A ∧ ¬B → ¬(A ∨ B)
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro p
  intro d
  elim 3
  elim 4 THENL [
    elim 5 with u1 THENL [hyp, hyp],
    elim 6 with v1 THENL [hyp, hyp]
  ]
qed

-- One De Morgan direction for ∧ is constructive; the converse needs EM.
theorem de_morgan_and :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. ¬A ∨ ¬B → ¬(A ∧ B)
proof
  intro A
  intro B
  intro d
  intro p
  elim 4
  elim 3 THENL [
    elim 7 with u THENL [hyp, hyp],
    elim 7 with v THENL [hyp, hyp]
  ]
qed

theorem noncontradiction :
  ∀A:U{i}. ¬(A ∧ ¬A)
proof
  intro A
  intro p
  elim 2
  elim 4 with u THENL [hyp, hyp]
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Squash: hide an extract
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem squash_intro :
  ∀A:U{i}. A → [A]
proof
  intro A
  intro a
  intro
  hyp
qed

theorem squash_true :
  [True]
proof
  intro
  intro
qed

-- The extract of a squash is always `Ax`.
theorem squash_ax :
  Ax ∈ [True]
proof
  auto
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Automation
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem prove_prop_k :
  ∀A:U{i}. ∀B:U{i}. A → B → A
proof
  prove_prop
qed

theorem unfold_true :
  True
proof
  unfold
  intro
qed
